workspace.platformsDescription: Choose the local agents managed by this workspace.
workspace.backupDescription: Keep a durable copy before AskAgent X changes a platform link.
workspace.languageDescription: This preference is shared by the Web and CLI and is saved immediately.
workspace.syncDescription: The Web watches the same revision used by every CLI command.
workspace.skillsDescription: Read-only discovery is available now. Transactional changes unlock after the safety chain is complete.
workspace.feedbackMinPlatform: Keep at least one Agent platform

skills.title: Connect your local Skills.
skills.description: Choose the Agents to manage, then let AskX scan local capabilities read-only. Scanning and adjustment only record pending changes; files change only when you save the final processing results.
skills.platformTitle: Choose platforms to scan and connect
skills.platformDescription: Platform options are Skills directories preset by AskX for the current operating system. They use the same directory scanner as selected folders. On final save, each selected platform's whole Skills directory points to the AskX canonical source.
skills.customFolderDescription: Select multiple directories at once. Choose either an individual Skill directory or a parent containing several Skills. They use the same read-only scanner as platform presets and never modify the originals.
skills.noCustomFolders: Optional: no extra folders added. AskX will scan only the Agent platforms selected above.
skills.folderSelectionFailed: AskX could not open or read the local directories. Choose them again.
skills.scanDescription: AskX merged same-name copies across platforms and selected safe defaults. This step only records each Skill's pending change and does not modify local files or symlinks; AskX applies them only when you save the processing results in the final step.
skills.finalSkillListDescription: Each row is one merged Skill. The current selection is only recorded as a pending change to be saved later.
skills.decisionSelectDescription: The current selection is only recorded as pending and does not modify local files immediately.
skills.noMatchingSkillsDescription: Try another search term or filter.
skills.noSkillDescription: This Skill does not provide a description.
skills.fullDescriptionHint: Read the complete description provided in this Skill's metadata.
skills.syncPlatformSkillsTip: Scan this platform and sync its Skills into the AskX canonical source without changing the platform directory or link state.
skills.syncDialogDescription: Scan this platform read-only and write confirmed Skills into the AskX canonical source without changing the platform directory or symlink state.
skills.syncScanDescription: AskX compared this platform with the canonical source read-only. Selections here are only pending; saving updates the AskX canonical source while leaving the platform directory and symlink state unchanged.
skills.syncConfirmDescription: This save only updates the AskX canonical Skill source after staging and verification. It never changes the platform directory or creates, suspends, or restores a platform symlink.
skills.syncPlanTitle: Sync only into the AskX canonical source
skills.syncPlanDescription: The current platform is a read-only source. Its Skills directory and existing symlink relationship are not part of this action plan.
skills.syncOperationKeep: Keep the current AskX canonical version and do not sync this Skill from the platform
skills.syncOperationSelectSource: Use this read-only source to update the AskX canonical source: {path}
skills.syncOperationReplace: Use the selected version to update the AskX canonical source: {path}
skills.noSyncFilesDescription: No Skills were found on this platform. The AskX canonical source, platform directory, and symlink state remain unchanged.
skills.syncApplying: Validating and updating the canonical source…
skills.syncResultDescription: The selected Skills were written and verified in the AskX canonical source. The platform directory and symlink state were not changed.
skills.syncNoChanges: This platform had no Skills to write into the canonical source, so nothing changed.
skills.platformEmpty: No Skills found on this platform
skills.adoptResult: This only records the item as “Adopt”. On final save, AskX writes the Skill to the canonical source, which platforms access through their whole Skills directory proxy.
skills.mergeResult: This only records the item as “Merge”. On final save, AskX consolidates identical copies into one Skill in the canonical source.
skills.keepResult: This only records the item as “Do not import”. The Skill does not enter the new canonical source; its original platform Skills directory is retained as a restorable whole-directory backup.
skills.replaceResult: This only records the item as “Use this version”. On final save, AskX writes the selected version into the canonical source and backs up the original platform directory as a whole.
skills.renameResult: This only records the item as “Rename and adopt”. On final save, AskX writes the content into the canonical source under the new name.
skills.archiveResult: This only records the item as “Delete (recoverable)”. AskX moves selected copies into backups only when you save the processing results in the final step; nothing is physically deleted.
skills.archiveHint: Original content moves into AskX backups and is never physically deleted.
skills.chooseArchiveCopies: Choose copies to move into backup
skills.confirmDescription: This is the only step that changes files. AskX first builds and verifies the complete canonical source, then connects each platform's whole Skills directory one at a time. A platform failure restores and marks only that platform while the others continue.
skills.operationKeep: Do not import; retain the original in the whole platform-directory backup
skills.operationArchive: Do not import; retain this path in the platform-directory backup: {path}
skills.operationReplace: Use this version; retain the original in the whole platform-directory backup: {path}
skills.noFilesDescription: AskX creates an empty canonical source and connects each selected platform's whole Skills directory to it. Existing platform directories are backed up first.
skills.applying: Building the canonical source and switching platform directories…
skills.resultDescription: The canonical source is built and verified, and each selected platform now connects its whole Skills directory to the same source.
skills.resultPartialTitle: Canonical source saved; some platforms failed
skills.resultPartialDescription: Successful platforms are using the canonical source. Failed platforms were restored and recorded, and can be imported again individually from Skills X.
skills.rootBindingDescription: Each platform receives one directory-level symlink and is connected as an independent sub-transaction. One platform failure does not affect the others.
skills.emptyCanonicalConnected: The canonical source is empty, and the selected platform Skills directories are connected. Add Skills directly to the canonical source.
skills.managerDescription: Manage local Skills from one canonical directory and point each selected Agent's whole Skills directory to it—maintain once, reuse everywhere.
skills.listDescription: Managed Skills and unmanaged copies found locally are listed together here.
skills.resourceDescription: Browse Skills in the canonical source, inspect versions, descriptions and full file structures, and maintain content through a protected update flow.
skills.unsavedFileHint: Save or discard the current file changes before switching.
skills.selectFileDescription: Choose a text file from the structure. Symlinks and binary files are shown but never followed or read.
skills.saveFileConfirmDescription: AskX revalidates the manifest, complete Skill and current file fingerprints before saving. Only this managed file changes, and failures restore the original content.
skills.fileSaved: The Skill file was updated and verified.
skills.fileChanged: The Skill or file changed elsewhere. Refresh and edit again.
skills.fileRequestFailed: AskX could not read or update the Skill file. Check the resource state.
skills.canonicalReadyHint: This is the only Skills directory. Each selected Agent's whole Skills root points here through one managed symlink.
skills.canonicalPendingHint: On final save, AskX builds the complete canonical source first, then connects each platform's whole Skills directory one at a time. A failed platform is restored independently; platform directories remain unchanged until then.
skills.clearCanonicalSourceTip: Clear the canonical source without changing platform links. Non-empty content is backed up first.
skills.canonicalBackupManagerDescription: Backups are named by date and that day's sequence. Restore one or permanently delete it; deleted backups cannot be recovered.
skills.noCanonicalBackupsDescription: Clearing a non-empty source creates backup 01. Additional clears on the same day increment the sequence.
skills.clearCanonicalSourceWithBackupDescriptio: AskX first creates and verifies a durable backup, then clears the canonical source and managed Skill records. Platform links stay connected to the now-empty directory.
skills.clearCanonicalSourceEmptyDescription: The canonical source has no files, so AskX will not create an empty backup. It only verifies and clears stale managed Skill records.
skills.restoreCanonicalBackupDescription: This replaces the current canonical source and managed Skill records with the selected version while preserving platform links. Failures restore the pre-operation state.
skills.deleteCanonicalBackupDescription: This permanently removes the selected backup files. AskX cannot recover them afterward, and the current source and platform links are not changed.
skills.canonicalSourcePlanRevalidate: AskX revalidates the manifest, canonical source, and target backup before applying. Any changed state stops safely.
skills.canonicalSourceClearedWithBackup: The canonical source was cleared and its previous content was saved as a durable backup.
skills.canonicalSourceAlreadyEmpty: The canonical source is already empty, so no backup was created.
skills.canonicalBackupRestored: The canonical source backup was restored and platform links were preserved.
skills.canonicalBackupRequestFailed: Could not read canonical source backups. Try again.
skills.canonicalSourceActionFailed: The canonical source or backup changed. Nothing was applied; reopen the action and try again.
skills.suspendPlatformLinkDescription: This only disconnects the platform link and restores the pre-connection Skills directory from its backup as-is. No Skill is scanned, copied, merged, or rewritten. Any failure restores the state from before this operation.
skills.resumePlatformLinkDescription: This only moves the platform's original directory back to its existing backup location and restores the managed link. It does not sync any Skill. Occupied paths stop safely and completed moves are rolled back.
skills.suspendPlatformLinkHint: The pre-connection platform directory is restored; neither it nor the AskX canonical source is rewritten.
skills.resumePlatformLinkHint: The root link is restored and the platform's original directory is kept as-is at its original backup location; no Skill is scanned or synchronized.
skills.platformLinkSuspended: The platform link was disconnected and its pre-connection directory was restored as-is, without synchronizing or modifying any Skill.
skills.platformLinkResumed: The platform link was restored and its original directory was returned to the backup location as-is, without synchronizing or modifying any Skill.
skills.platformLinkActionFailed: The platform link action failed. Check the path state and try again.
skills.setupEmptyTitle: Skill management is not initialized yet.
skills.setupEmptyDescription: Use the guide to choose platforms and record pending changes for local Skills, then save the processing results in the final step to complete the first adoption.
skills.setupDialogDescription: AskX first scans platform and selected folders read-only. On final save, it builds the complete canonical source and connects each selected platform's whole Skills directory to it.
skills.transactionDescription: AskX restores from the latest batch first and revalidates the manifest, canonical source and platform root proxies before changing files.
skills.restoreConfirmDescription: Recovery removes the platform root proxies and canonical source created by AskX, then restores each original platform Skills directory from backup as a whole.
skills.restoreBackupHint: If a platform root proxy, canonical source or manifest changed externally, AskX stops recovery and does not overwrite current content.
skills.restoreFailed: Recovery failed. The local state may have changed; scan again and review the receipt.
skills.emptyTitle: The orbit is ready, with no Skills yet.
skills.emptyDescription: AskX remembers your management scope. Add a local Skill and scan again whenever you are ready.
skills.requestFailed: The operation failed. Scan again and retry.
skills.settingsConflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload this page.
